name: linear-cost-tuning
description: Analyze and reduce the infrastructure and quota cost of a Linear integration through workload accounting, query budgets, and push-based updates. Use when a sync is wasteful, throttled, or expensive to operate. Trigger with "reduce Linear API load", "budget Linear queries", or "tune Linear integration cost".

findings.excerpt: Use `Read`, `Glob`, and `Grep` to inspect code, configuration, and evidence. Use `WebFetch` only for current first-party Linear documentation and package metada
